# STEP 3 — Primary Parameters Computed from Raw Data

```{r}
param_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Population at risk (N)",
                "Growth rate (r)",
                "Recovery rate (γ)",
                "Mortality rate (μ)",
                "Transmission rate (β = r + γ + μ)",
                "Basic reproduction number (R₀ = β / (γ + μ))"),
  Value     = c(format(N_total, big.mark = ","),
                sprintf("%.4f /day", growth_rate),
                sprintf("%.4f /day", gamma_est),
                sprintf("%.4f /day", mu_est),
                sprintf("%.4f /day", beta_est),
                sprintf("%.3f",       R0_est))
)
knitr::kable(param_table, caption = "Primary parameters from raw observations")
```

**Key calculations**

- Growth rate: log-linear regression on the first 30 % of the cumulative
  case series, `log(I(t)) ~ a + r·t`.
- Recovery rate: `γ = 1 / 10 days`.
- Mortality rate: `μ = CFR / 100` using the latest observed CFR.
- Transmission rate: closed-form from the SIR early-phase identity
  `r = β − γ − μ`.
- Reproduction number: `R₀ = β / (γ + μ)`.

# STEP 4 — Model Generation (Training)

```{r}
# SIR with mortality (deSolve)
sir_model <- function(time, state, parms) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parms)), {
    N  <- S + I + R + D
    dS <- -beta * S * I / N
    dI <-  beta * S * I / N - (gamma + mu) * I
    dR <-  gamma * I
    dD <-  mu * I
    list(c(dS, dI, dR, dD))
  })
}

train_df <- as.data.frame(sir_train)
knitr::kable(head(train_df, 5),
             caption = "Trained SIR compartments — first 5 days")
```

# STEP 5 — Model Testing (Holdout)

```{r}
test_df <- data.frame(
  Day        = full_times[test_mask],
  Observed   = observed_I[test_mask],
```

# STEP 6 — Model Performance

```{r}
perf_tbl <- data.frame(
  Window  = c("Train", "Test", "Overall"),
  RMSE    = round(c(train_perf$rmse, test_perf$rmse, overall$rmse), 2),
  MAE     = round(c(train_perf$mae,  test_perf$mae,  overall$mae),  2),

)
knitr::kable(perf_tbl, caption = "SIR model performance metrics")
```

# SIR Compartments with β, γ, μ Reference Lines

```{r sir-compartments, fig.height=6}
sir_long <- sir_full %>%
  select(time, S, I, R, D) %>%
  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "compartment", values_to = "value")

ggplot(sir_long, aes(x = time, y = value, colour = compartment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = max(sir_long$time), y = beta_est,
           label = sprintf("β = %.3f", beta_est),  hjust = 1, colour = "#c0392b") +
  annotate("text", x = max(sir_long$time), y = gamma_est,
           label = sprintf("γ = %.3f", gamma_est), hjust = 1, colour = "#27ae60") +
  annotate("text", x = max(sir_long$time), y = mu_est,
           label = sprintf("μ = %.3f", mu_est),    hjust = 1, colour = "#8e44ad") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(beta_est, gamma_est, mu_est),
             linetype = "dotted",
             colour  = c("#c0392b", "#27ae60", "#8e44ad"),
             linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Days since first report", y = "Individuals",
       title = "SIR compartments with β, γ, μ reference lines",
       colour = "Compartment") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
